# Bevel UI

> Fully-engineered UI systems for React. Copy the code, own it forever. No lock-in.

Bevel UI is a collection of production-ready UI systems for React developers.
Unlike component libraries, each system solves a complete engineering problem —
state architecture, edge cases, and composable API included.

Built on: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui
Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://bevelui.vercel.app/r/[system-name].json

## Free Systems

- **Product Tour** — Viewport-aware guided tours. SVG mask overlay, floating card positioning via @floating-ui/react, keyboard navigation, media support. https://bevelui.vercel.app/docs/components/product-tour
- **Command Palette** — ⌘K command menu with custom fuzzy search (no Fuse.js), two-tier tab filtering, grouped results, avatar support. https://bevelui.vercel.app/docs/components/command-palette
- **File Upload** — Drag-and-drop with per-file state machine (idle→uploading→done/error), cancel via AbortController, retry, grid/list views. https://bevelui.vercel.app/docs/components/file-upload
- **Form Engine** — Multi-step form orchestration. Config-driven or headless. Plugin architecture. Per-step Zod validation. Conditional fields. https://bevelui.vercel.app/docs/components/form-engine
- **Sortable** — Drag-to-reorder for lists and CSS grids. Built on @dnd-kit. Handle mode, drag overlay, useSortableList hook. https://bevelui.vercel.app/docs/components/sortable
- **Color Palette** — Visual palette editor with 2D HSV picker. Export to hex array, CSS variables, Tailwind config, HSL strings. https://bevelui.vercel.app/docs/components/palette

## Pro Systems ($49 one-time)

- **Properties Panel** — Figma-style panel with seven typed control rows. Config-driven or headless. Uses shadcn Input, Select, Switch, Slider. https://bevelui.vercel.app/docs/components/properties-panel
- **AI Chat Interface** — Streaming chat UI with thinking blocks, tool call display, markdown rendering, file attachments. Model-agnostic. https://bevelui.vercel.app/docs/components/ai-chat

## Bevel Labs

Six fully functional demo applications built entirely with Bevel systems.
Vault (file manager), Onboard (SaaS onboarding), Launchpad (deployment dashboard),
Intake (job application form), Briefcase (client handoff), Compass (settings hub).

Source code available with Pro license.

Quick start: https://bevelui.vercel.app/docs/quick-start

- Pro: $49 one-time — all Pro systems + Bevel Labs source code
